## holt 0.4.4 — release proof reuse

Install the signed, version-pinned GitHub release artifact:

```bash
npm install -g https://github.com/Raed2180416/holt/releases/download/v0.4.4/holt.tgz
```

The bare `holt` npm registry name is not an official distribution. Do not use
`npm install -g holt`; use the exact GitHub release URL.

This patch consumes the checksum-bound complete proof once. The proof already runs the complete
test corpus and full mutation fingerprint; the stable-tag quality lane now verifies those retained
denominators and public-number claims instead of rerunning the same expensive suites and timing
out before signing. This is a release-process correction, not evidence of customer adoption,
productivity gains, universal host enforcement, or a commercial service.

### Verify this exact artifact

After downloading `holt.tgz` and the release assets:

```bash
gh release verify v0.4.4 --repo Raed2180416/holt
gh release verify-asset v0.4.4 holt.tgz --repo Raed2180416/holt
gh attestation verify holt.tgz --repo Raed2180416/holt
holt audit --require-signature
```

Each command verifies a different boundary. Do not infer provenance if the attestation query does
not succeed.

For the full change ledger and remaining gaps, see the
[post-v0.3.1 55-commit audit](https://github.com/Raed2180416/holt/blob/v0.4.4/docs/research/2026-08-13-post-v0.3.1-55-commit-audit.md).
